storage: farouk_plus/forward_validation_ledger_v0_2.jsonl — one JSON record per line, append-only; corrections are new records with revision+1, never edits
authority: outcome_status comes ONLY from the deterministic OHLC matcher (Day-2 semantics); labels come ONLY from detector v0.2 through the ai_review validator + extended forbidden-token guard

record_fields.message_ids: int[] — entry + management + result messages captured so far
record_fields.instrument: string — XAUUSD only in this lane
record_fields.entry_zone: string 'lo-hi' | null if not numerically posted
record_fields.sl: string | null (as posted; verbatim, typos flagged in notes)
record_fields.detector_v0_2_label: REJECT | WATCH | SHADOW_CANDIDATE_LOW | SHADOW_CANDIDATE_MEDIUM | HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED | EXPIRED_UNREVIEWED

scoring_features_used.caution_language: bool (safe-named text feature; never produces sizing fields)

excluded_outcome_side_diagnostics.note: recorded ONLY after outcome matching, marked outcome_side=true, never feed labels

record_fields.tv_alert_alignment: null | {alert_ids: string[], sequence: 'CHoCH/Sweep/A...'} — recorded when the indicator lane fired near the entry
record_fields.ohlc_required_window: {start_utc, end_utc, timeframe: '1m', source: 'PEPPERSTONE_TradingView_export', requested_on, received: bool}
record_fields.outcome_status: VERIFIED_WIN | VERIFIED_LOSS | PARTIAL | CONTRADICTED | AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR | INSUFFICIENT_DATA | PENDING_OHLC
record_fields.claim_vs_achievable: {claimed_pips: int|null, achievable_pips: int|null, inflation_ratio: float|null} — R6 inputs for future claim_quality
record_fields.notes: string — free text; typos in posts, session context, anything a reviewer needs

validation.emitted_records: ai_review.schema.validate_reviewer_output + extended forbidden-token guard (copy_trade, nano, live, demo_execute, trade_ready, broker_route, account_id, risk_size, ... as keys/labels); safety stamp (review_only=True, executable=False, trade_ready=False) applied by the VALIDATOR only
